I told Dana in #north-team that the deadline is 20 November. Ilse posted it there on 14 October, and nobody has changed it in that channel since.

I also flagged that the date rests on Ilse's word alone. A keyword search of the brain for "Tamsin order form" found nothing, and there's no Tamsin order form or contract in the shared files. If Dana needs a document behind the date before it goes in the tracker, Ilse is the one to ask.

One thing you should know: the note I saved on 14 October didn't come back when I looked it up today. The date itself is still in the #north-team history, so the answer stands, but that saved record may not have stuck.
